text: [Owner] Which day is the bin collection in our street?
Bin collection in your street is on Thursday mornings; put the green bin out on Wednesday night.
[Owner] Remember that I switched my phone plan to Kestrel Mobile last week.
Noted: your phone plan is now with Kestrel Mobile.
[Owner] I've decided the garden gets drip irrigation this summer, no more hand watering.
For the bike commute I suggest the river path: it is flatter and about ten minutes faster than the main road.
For the Lantern battery check, test each returned cell at 3.7 volts before shipping a replacement pack.
[Owner] Мой любимый маршрут для пробежки — вдоль канала до старой мельницы.
Nightly summary: nothing new about the bin collection or the garden.
